## Problem

What can't you do today, or what's awkward about the current behavior? Prefer
describing the underlying need over jumping straight to a specific implementation —
it leaves room to find a simpler fix.

## Proposed change

What you'd like to see instead. If it touches config, name the section/field you'd
expect (see `deploy/config.example.yaml` for the existing shape); if it touches an
MCP tool, name which one and what the new parameter/behavior would be.

## Alternatives considered (optional)

Other ways to solve the same problem, and why you're not proposing them instead.
